core_problem_solved: To provide the necessary runtime library for applications to execute parsers that were generated by the ANTLR 4 tool. This library contains the core parsing engine, parse tree data structures, and APIs for traversing the tree.
key_features: The core ANTLR 4 parsing engine (Adaptive LL(*))
APIs for parse tree traversal (Listeners and Visitors)
Data structures for representing the parse tree (e.g., `ParserRuleContext`)
era_and_niche: The essential runtime dependency for any modern application that uses an ANTLR v4-generated parser. It is the current, actively maintained standard for ANTLR.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the current, standard runtime for ANTLR 4. Migration would typically only involve upgrading to a newer version of the runtime to match the version of the ANTLR 4 tool being used.
